Title: Raider to the Death
Descriptions: Unlike those who chose to affiliate themselves with a cooperative faction, the undecided or unwilling remain Raiders, and live as outcasts. As a Raider increasing your notoriety could make you a public enemy, unable to ever participate in the human social structure again. You would have no access to traders of any kind, and might be better off infected... Remember, so long as you remain a Raider you are redeemable and can join a faction at any time. But if you do enough horrible acts you will become something else entirely, that which no one can forgive. You still have time to change your ways.
You still have time to change your ways.
ObjectiveText: I'll give you one more warning.
